concept: A phone’s main navigation in a floating pill dock at thumb reach, the current destination as chosen glass with a semibold label.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a full-width white tab bar pinned to the bottom with a coloured active icon (iOS tab bar, Material bottom navigation)
default_to_avoid.kind: bottom navigation, tab bar, bottom nav, dock
default_to_avoid.why_not: a coloured active icon is a hue and the only cue; a full-width white bar ignores the glass

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: a floating level-1 pill over the content, clear of the screen edge

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the current destination is chosen glass with a semibold label, marked by shape and weight

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: every destination is at least 64 by 52px, at thumb reach

variants.reason: A is the dock from the reference, glass with a chosen pane. B is the OS bar. C drops the labels readers need.

dock.why: a level-1 glass pill holding the destinations, the same in every theme and on every scene

fixed.why: floats at the bottom centre of the viewport

contained.why: sits in its parent for a panel or a demo

item.why: a destination with its icon over its label, a large target

icon.why: the icon at the icon size, the same in every theme and on every scene

label.why: the destination’s one word in the micro size

badge.why: a count as a small loud mark, the same in every theme and on every scene

sr.why: the count in words for a screen reader

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring so a keyboard user sees which item has focus

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours mark the current item with the system highlight

hover.why: a destination lightens under the pointer, the same in every theme and on every scene

aria-current=page.why: the current destination is chosen glass with a semibold label

aria-current.why: the current destination does not lighten on hover, because it is already the chosen pane

background-color.why: the tint eases at hover pace, the same in every theme and on every scene
